summary: BIND DNS security fixes (CVE-2026-75029, CVE-2026-19666, CVE-2026-19662, CVE-2026-19941, and more), CIFS utilities security fix (CVE-2026-104715), systemd bug fixes, and bootc enhancement.

changes.description: Libraries used by the BIND DNS packages
changes.note:
# Security updates using git snapshot

Release 9.18 is end-of-life upstream. Apply security fixes including medium CVEs from somehow maintained git branch bind-9.18.

- [CVE-2026-75029](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-75029) Discard repeated SOA, CNAME, and DNAME records when parsing DNS messages
- [CVE-2026-19666](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-19666) DNS64 with break-dnssec could cause an assertion failure
- [CVE-2026-19662](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-19662) Prevent resolver crash with cached DNSSEC proofs
- [CVE-2026-19941](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-19941) Prevent forged DNSSEC-validated NXDOMAIN responses
- [CVE-2026-78301](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-78301) Out-of-zone records in a zone database could be served as authoritative
- [CVE-2026-81563](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-81563) Following HTTPS/SVCB aliases could leak resolver cache memory
- [CVE-2026-80274](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-80274) Crash on wildcard answers carrying both NSEC and NSEC3 proofs
- [CVE-2026-19033](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-19033) Require a TSIG on every message of incoming zone transfers
- [CVE-2026-81736](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-81736) Cached HTTPS/SVCB aliases could exhaust resolver CPU
- [CVE-2026-19667](https://kb.isc.org/docs/CVE-2026-19667) Reject negative cache records that do not fit in a dns_rdata_t
